Game Overview

Angry Snake is a snake title where guide your snake through a colorful, vibrant world, consuming orbs to grow stronger while avoiding treacherous obstacles. Unlock exciting skins and power-ups as you strategize to conquer increasingly challenging levels. Every move requires sharp reflexes in this thrilling quest for high scores and endless arcade excitement.
